editorial:
Imagine coming home to find out your husband is cheating on you with the person you hired to look after your kids. That is exactly the nightmare you get into with this flick. You follow a wife who is just trying to keep her family together while dealing with a nanny who is way more dangerous than she looks. The vibe is very tense from the start, making you feel the stress of a home that no longer feels safe. It starts as a drama about a broken marriage but quickly turns into a scary game of cat and mouse as people around the husband start turning up dead.

You will notice that the twists keep coming just when you think you have the mystery figured out. While some of the acting is a bit over the top, it fits the style of a TV thriller perfectly. The pacing moves fast, so you will not get bored. If you enjoy stories about secret identities and betrayal, you should definitely check this out. It is a solid choice if you want something easy and exciting to watch.
endingExplained: You find out that the nanny was not just a random gold digger, but a calculated killer with a dark past. She manipulated the husband to get close to the family for her own gain. After a tense final showdown where the wife has to fight back to save her children, the nanny is finally stopped. The movie ends with the family safe, though their marriage is completely destroyed by the lies and the violence they endured.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves domestic thrillers and shocking plot twists.
